name: FFmpeg Transcode
description: Publishes the bundled ffmpeg binary's path for other features to spawn: core video-codec compatibility transcode, party channel thumbnail capture, and any plugin that pipes live audio through it. Bundled with the app and enabled by default — disabling it turns those features off (a clear warning shows in each) rather than breaking the app. Isolated as its own plugin because the bundled ffmpeg binary is GPL-3.0-or-later licensed, distinct from this app's own MIT license.
